title: Ankhorage API Next.js Adapter
summary: Adapts the Ankhorage API runtime to Next.js App Router request, response, and route boundaries.
purpose: Host portable Ankhorage APIs in Next.js without coupling the framework-neutral runtime to Next.js filesystem routing or runtime types.
responsibilities: Translate Web Request and Response values at the Next.js transport boundary.
Create thin App Router bindings for portable API definitions.
Expose inspection of the resulting Next.js route projection.
boundaries: Does not own API operation dispatch or handler semantics.
Does not own portable API contracts.
Does not add Next.js filesystem or runtime dependencies to @ankhorage/api.
audience: Next.js applications hosting APIs defined through the Ankhorage API runtime.
useCases: Bind a portable API definition to Next.js App Router handlers.
Translate a Next.js request through the canonical API runtime.
Inspect the projected Next.js routes for an API definition.

invariants: Framework translation stays at the adapter edge.
